CREATE VIEW vw_peak_hours AS
WITH trips AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://adlstransproject.dfs.core.windows.net/transportationdata/curated_parquet/trips/**',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) AS t
)
SELECT
    hour_of_day,
    SUM(passenger_count) AS total_passengers,
    COUNT(*) AS total_trips
FROM trips
GROUP BY hour_of_day;
